description: This file defines a custom React hook named useClock, which provides a ticking clock with options to source time locally or from a backend API. It manages timer updates, respects page visibility changes to optimize resource usage, and interacts with external utility functions to fetch or compute time data.

methods.name: useClock(timezone = 'UTC')
methods.description: A React hook that provides real-time clock updates, choosing between local system time and backend API time based on configuration and connectivity. It manages intervals efficiently, adapting update frequency when the tab is hidden.
